stories.title: Baldwin Wallace football earns 1st-round bye, will host D-III playoff game on Nov. 28
stories.summary: The Yellow Jackets wrapped up their first undefeated regular season since 1991, earning a bye through the first round of the NCAA Division III football playoffs.

stories.title: 40 years later, families fight to keep Akron students' killer behind bars as parole hearing looms
stories.summary: Clinton Dickens — who kidnapped, raped, and murdered Wendy Offredo and Dawn McCreery in 1986 — is up for parole. Their families are hoping he stays behind bars.

stories.title: The Gathering Place's new CEO Adam Ross aims to expand free cancer support services across Northeast Ohio
stories.summary: The Bay Village native is building on nearly 27 years of service while working to reach more families affected by cancer, including those facing barriers to care.

stories.title: Judge dismisses Northeast Ohio US Rep. Max Miller's defamation suit against ex-wife, calling her abuse claim 'substantially true'
stories.summary: A judge has dismissed Rep. Max Miller's defamation lawsuit against his ex-wife, citing Ohio's anti-SLAPP law and ruling her abuse claim to be 'substantially true.'

stories.title: Akron shooting: 15-year-old boy killed, 14-year-old boy hospitalized with multiple gunshot wounds
stories.summary: ​"When officers arrived, they found two teenagers on the front porch of a residence with gunshot wounds."

stories.title: 1 dead, 3 taken to hospital after crash involving RTA van in Cleveland
stories.summary: According to Cleveland EMS, a 60-year-old woman was pronounced dead at the scene.

stories.title: Wadsworth heart warrior nicknamed 'Iron Man' among 12 finalists in Stan Lee’s Super Kid contest
stories.summary: Dakota Schneck has lived with a pacemaker since he was 3 months old. Now the 6-year-old is in the running to star in his own Stan Lee Universe comic book.

stories.title: Broadview Heights fire that killed North Royalton firefighter Ryan Milligan ruled accidental
stories.summary: The Ohio Division of State Fire Marshall determined the Nov. 2 fire that claimed the life of North Royalton firefighter Ryan Milligan was accidental in nature.

stories.title: City of Cleveland's CFO Paul Barrett resigns, Kevin Preslan appointed to replace him
stories.summary: Assistant Director of Finance Kevin Preslan has been appointed to take over the position.

stories.title: Perry Local Schools in Stark County to reopen Tuesday following 'cyber incident'; some tech access to remain 'limited'
stories.summary: Classes at Perry Local Schools will resume tomorrow following an unspecified 'cyber incident,' though some technology usage will remain limited.

stories.title: Akron man sentenced for sexually abusing a child
stories.summary: Johnathan Patrick, 29, faces the possibility of life in prison after being sentenced for sexually abusing a child under the age of 13.
